name: Strata
description: Lightweight Git-backed key-value store: operation journal, periodic snapshots and asynchronous publish queue (local JSON or Codeberg).

STORAGE.description: Backing store. Heroku containers have no persistent disk, so use Codeberg.

CODEBERG_REPO.description: Private Codeberg repository holding snapshot.json and the journal.

CODEBERG_TOKEN.description: Codeberg access token with read+write on the repository (never exposed to browsers).

API_TOKEN.description: Optional. Long random secret required as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

CORS_ORIGIN.description: Optional. Exact origin of your app (e.g. https://app.example) for public APIs.

JOURNAL_SNAPSHOT_EVERY.description: Journal operations published before a new snapshot is written.

WRITE_QUEUE_DEBOUNCE_MS.description: Idle time after the last mutation before publishing a burst.

WRITE_QUEUE_INTERVAL_MS.description: Minimum rest between publish cycles (also the retry delay).
